items.raw_excerpt: Onion prices soar to ₹62/kg as government blames middlemen; farmers demand intervention for fair pricing and support.
items.summary_en: Onion prices in India have jumped to ₹62 per kilogram. The government says middlemen are behind the price rise. Farmers are asking for fair pricing and government support.

items.raw_excerpt: Aug 27 : Argentina have kept the same starting line-up from their narrow loss to world champions South Africa earlier this month for Saturday’s first test against Australia.• Coach Felipe Contepomi must again do without many of his overseas-based players but has opted for consistency after the narrow 17-1
items.summary_en: Argentina coach Felipe Contepomi has named the same starting fifteen for Saturday's test match against Australia. The team nearly beat South Africa in their last game. Contepomi again rests his overseas-based players but wants consistency.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite paying for deliveries to be sent to their homes, residents in parts of regional Tasmania were told they had seven days to pick up their packages hours away at the company's depot in Hobart. After the ABC aired resident complaints, Team Global Express reversed the decision.
items.summary_en: Residents in parts of regional Tasmania were told to pick up their paid deliveries at a depot in Hobart, hours away. ABC reported the complaints, and Team Global Express changed its decision and reinstated deliveries.

items.raw_excerpt: Earth is constantly humming with an ultra-low-frequency vibration that can be picked up right across the globe which has puzzled seismologists for decades. Growing evidence suggests it's the collective sound of the world's oceans constantly moving.
items.summary_en: Earth constantly hums with a very low-frequency vibration that is heard around the world. Scientists have wondered about this for decades. New evidence suggests it is the collective sound of the world's oceans constantly moving.

items.title_en: Could ocean waves be making Earth hum?
